properties.description: a_retired_tool_is_a_counted_stub_and_its_survivor_does_its_job.rs (in_memory program, over a real MCP session): the fifteen stubs are listed with their RETIRED mark and read-only, each refuses an ordinary 0.95.0 call with "REFUSED: ... RETIRED on 2026-10-30 ... What to do ... 2026-12-23" and leaves every node and edge as it was, a fold's refusal carries the exact survivor call built from the caller's arguments, and find_tools never offers one; propagate_from with one ChangeEvent seed equals propagate_change_kept field for field plus seeded_by_change (and a change among several seeds is walked as a node, said); dimension_drifts with target_id and dimension equals dimension_drift_kept; graph_report format markdown equals graph_report_markdown_kept's document; add_verification with id and verifies keeps name, method, level, description, status, last_run_at, findings and location; one-item set_artifact_checksums and acknowledge_gaps do the one-item jobs. With it: tools/test_feedback_is_a_computed_tally.py 5b on the real binary (a stub call is in the ledger under its own name as a refusal; usage_report's retired_stubs counts it, the uncalled at 0), tools/smoke_mcp.py §7 and §7b2, no_served_text_names_a_tool_that_is_not_served (stubs unnamed in served text), every_tool_is_found_by_a_query_in_the_users_words (stubs never ranked).
